text: Wrenfield's real knowledge sits in three Blob Storage folders: HR policies, an IT wiki export, and Ops SOPs -- about 545 documents total, nobody's ever made searchable.
The plan: ingest every file in all three folders, no manual curation. These are each team's normal working folders, not an unreviewed inbox, so hand-vetting 545 documents isn't worth the delay.
Every document gets chunked at roughly 500 tokens with a 50-token overlap, so an idea split across a chunk boundary still shows up whole somewhere.
Every chunk carries its filename, which folder it came from, and its position in the document -- without that, a retrieved answer could never be traced back to a real source.
Next: before any of this gets built, planning exactly how we'd know the retrieved answers are actually good.
